prompt.generated_prompt_string: An adult woman with a bare face toys with a bamboo flute in the living room. She picks up the flute and spins it in her hand like Sun Wukong holding the Golden Cudgel, accidentally tossing it into the air while spinning. As she catches it, she changes outfit on the beat in slow motion. Use a photorealistic portrait-photography style, textured natural light, rich texture, gold and silver embellishment, and two outfits worn by the same adult woman. Her clothes use sequin gauze, sequin velvet, organza, exquisite lace, tassels, embroidery, prints, complex draped folds, gorgeous accessories, and dark patterns on traditional clothes. The background is dark with jacquard cloud-brocade curtains and a sea of double-petaled flowers. Use dynamic composition, shallow depth of field, light spots in dark areas, and moon white as the main color scheme. Use internet pop music.
